top_events.title: Merz vows to keep coalition together for Germany's 'democratic future'
top_events.label: Merz pledges coalition unity after defeats
top_events.summary: German chancellor commits to maintaining coalition despite state election losses, continuing political uncertainty in key EU partner that affects Ukraine's Western support stability.

top_events.summary: Military analysts examine whether Ukraine's Pelican is a tactical ballistic missile or drone. Technical analysis of existing capability, not a new battlefield development.
